summary: @or-sdk/knowledge-models preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-package payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated and, on install, checks for a `bun` binary on PATH; if absent it downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts the `bun` executable, chmods it, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` from the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (obfuscator.io-style rotated string array `n7gIxM`, rotation routine `WV8StW`, per-string decoder `hc1jfK9`, `_0x`-style identifiers, labeled `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that runs only under Bun and not under Node. The `math_init` name has no relation to the package's declared `knowledge-models` SDK purpose. Downloading a secondary runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated payload at preinstall bypasses Node-based static analysis and dynamic hooks; the payload's actual behavior cannot be established without decoding the string array. This satisfies the install-time-rce fingerprint: automatic execution on default `npm install` of an obfuscated, purpose-mismatched in-tree payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
